يسررن (form I)
# يَسْرُرْنَ (yasrurna) /jas.rur.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of سَرَّ (sarra)
# يُسْرَرْنَ (yusrarna) /jus.rar.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of سَرَّ (sarra) and سُرَّ (surra)
# يَسْرَرْنَ (yasrarna) /jas.rar.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctiv
